surveys.name: HST
surveys.description: A heterogeneous pointed-observation archive. It is recorded as dated archive snapshots and products, not as a fictitious uniform DR sequence.

products.name: Instrument archive
products.description: Pointed imaging from instruments including ACS and WFC3.
products.reason: The aggregate published-pointings MOC is a discovery overview; exact instrument observation footprints for the audited snapshot have not been converted to an archive MOC.
products.manualStep: Query MAST for all public HST instrument observations available on 2026-08-12, parse each observation s_region footprint in ICRS, and union the footprints into the Instrument archive snapshot MOC.

products.name: Hubble Source Catalog
products.description: Cross-visit source catalog product.
products.reason: Published HiPS pointings do not establish exact Hubble Source Catalog coverage, and source-detection footprints for the audited snapshot have not been acquired.
products.manualStep: Query the Hubble Source Catalog available on 2026-08-12, collect the unique contributing HST observation identifiers, resolve each observation s_region footprint from MAST, and union those ICRS footprints into the catalog MOC.

products.name: Hubble Advanced Products
products.description: Processed science-ready archive products.
products.reason: Published HiPS pointings do not establish exact Hubble Advanced Products coverage, and product footprints for the audited snapshot have not been acquired.
products.manualStep: Query MAST for all public Hubble Advanced Products available on 2026-08-12, parse each product s_region footprint in ICRS, and union the footprints into the product MOC.
